exposure: Laparoscopic surgical repair of a symptomatic cesarean scar niche by the rendez-vous technique
outcome: niche-related symptoms (abnormal uterine bleeding, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, pelvic pain)
pregnancy and delivery of term babies
cohort: Patients with symptomatic cesarean scar defects (>=2 mm depth on transvaginal sonography) who underwent laparoscopic surgical repair using the rendez-vous technique between 2017 and 2020.
finding: Laparoscopic surgical repair of a symptomatic cesarean scar niche using the rendez-vous technique significantly increased residual myometrial thickness, reduced niche-related symptoms (abnormal uterine bleeding, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, pelvic pain), and improved secondary infertility.
